from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """An extracted classification pair for a single legal document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., 《判决文书 1》")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action category from the provided task list assigned to this document")
    evidence: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt or reasoning supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level container aggregating extractions for one or more documents."""
    classifications: list[DocumentClassification]
